senses.sense_definition: A biography that is excessively flattering, uncritically supportive, or treats its subject with unearned reverence.

examples.text: Critics dismissed the new book as an uncritical <w>hagiography</w> of the controversial political leader.
Rather than providing a balanced analysis, the film bordered on pure <w>hagiography</w>.

senses.sense_definition: A biography of a saint or venerated religious figure.

examples.text: The monk spent several years composing a detailed <w>hagiography</w> of the monastery's founding martyr.
Medieval readers frequently consulted this famous <w>hagiography</w> for moral and spiritual guidance.

senses.sense_definition: The academic study of saints and the literature concerning their lives and miracles.

examples.text: Her academic research focuses on the development of Christian <w>hagiography</w> during the early Middle Ages.
Students of medieval history must learn how to interpret <w>hagiography</w> within its theological context.
